# Brand & Trademark — Get Goods Gratis (Free)

*A single reference for the brand: name, slogan, logo, and the intended web address, plus the marks and colors
to protect. Prepared for counsel / brand review. Not legal advice — have your attorney confirm availability and
handle any trademark filings and the domain purchase.*

| | |
|---|---|
| **Brand name** | **Get Goods Gratis (Free)** |
| **Slogan / tagline** | **"Where Global Goods Gather"** |
| **Intended web address** | **getgoodsgratis.com** *(potential — verify availability & register)* |

## Logo

![Get Goods Gratis (Free) logo — gold "G-cubed" monogram on a navy rounded square](data:image/png;base64,)

*Vector source is included alongside this note as `gg-logo.svg` (and `brand-assets-gg-logo.png` for a raster
copy). The identical mark-only file is `gg-logo-mark.svg`. The app favicon/app icons derive from the same mark.*

### Logo specification

- **Concept:** a "G³" (G-cubed) monogram — the three G's of **Get Goods Gratis** — set as a large serif **G** with
  a superscript **3**, inside a rounded square.
- **Shape:** rounded square (viewBox 100×100, corner radius ~16), a gold keyline border, and a thin inner gold
  frame.
- **Typeface in the mark:** Georgia (serif), bold, for the "G" and the "3".

### Brand colors

| Role | Hex | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Navy (primary, dark) | `#16264f` → `#0a142e` | vertical gradient background of the mark |
| Gold (accent, light→deep) | `#f4e2a6` → `#e8c766` → `#b9942f` | the "G", the "3", and the border |
| Ink (deep navy) | `#0a142e` | darkest navy, shadows/wordmark |

## Slogan usage

- Present the slogan as **"Where Global Goods Gather"** (title case), typically beneath the wordmark.
- Today it appears in the site footer (under the wordmark) in the app UI. It is a **brand tagline**, not a claim
  about earnings, returns, or results — keep it descriptive of the marketplace, consistent with the platform's
  advertising-value (never revenue/ROI) compliance posture.

## Trademark & domain — for counsel

- **Marks to consider protecting:** the word mark **"Get Goods Gratis"**, the slogan **"Where Global Goods
  Gather"**, and the **"G³" logo** (design mark). Consider using **™** on first/prominent use now, and **®** only
  **after** a registration issues.
- **Clearance:** confirm the marks are available (USPTO / common-law search) and that the slogan and "Gratis"
  usage don't conflict before filing or heavy use.
- **Domain:** **getgoodsgratis.com** is the intended address — verify it's available and register it (a purchase;
  it can't be done from here). Consider grabbing close variants (`.co`, `.shop`, `.app`, and the
  `getgoodsgratis` handle on major platforms) to protect the brand.
- **Nothing here is filed or reserved yet** — this note just gathers the assets in one place for your attorney.
